title: INVISIBLE WORLD
tagline: Eight Invisible Friends on cloud karts, three laps through a dream that changes every lap.
blurb: A kart race on a road of rainbow glass 1.5 km round, high over a sea of clouds. Race eight Invisible Friends, each driving their own cloud: no bodies, only what they wear and carry. Every lap the dream changes, from Daydream to Deep Dream to Lucid Dream. Fly off the Daybreak cliff, dodge the rolling coins and toppling candles, grind the Whale Run rails, climb the Dream Tower, then drop down the Skyfall's three cliffs into Big Air. Most of the road is open to the sky, so drive off the edge and you fall.
